title: Indicator preservation with non-affine Walsh support
summary: Construct a nontrivial family of plateaued functions with non-affine Walsh support whose plateauedness survives the source-defined indicator modification.

formal_statement.body: Let $0<s<n$ with $n$ and $s$ of the source-required parity, and put $p=(n+s)/2$ and $q=(n-s)/2$. Construct an explicit nontrivial parameterized family of source-admissible tuples $(g,L)$ in which $g:\mathbb F_2^p\times\mathbb F_2^q\to\mathbb F_2$ is an $s$-plateaued function of the form $g(x,y)=x\cdot\phi(y)$, its Walsh support $S_g$ is not an affine subspace, and $L\le\mathbb F_2^p$ satisfies $\dim L\le q$, such that for every tuple in the family the modified function $f(x,y)=g(x,y)+\mathbf 1_{L^\perp}(x)$ is also $s$-plateaued.

scope.domain: Plateaued Boolean functions, Walsh support, and indicator modifications
assumptions: 0 < s < n and n,s have the parity required for p = (n+s)/2 and q = (n-s)/2
g(x,y) = x dot phi(y) is s-plateaued in the source setup
The Walsh support S_g is not an affine subspace
L is a linear subspace of F_2^p with dim(L) <= q
Each tuple (g,L) obeys the source conditions for the indicator modification
scope.unresolved_remainder: Construct at least one explicit nontrivial parameterized family of source-admissible tuples (g,L) with non-affine Walsh support and prove that every tuple yields an s-plateaued function after adding the indicator of L-perp.

progress.summary: The source asks for explicit non-affine-Walsh-support families whose plateauedness is preserved by its indicator construction.
